title: FLUX.2 Klein 9B, face and eye detailer
description: Finds the faces in a picture by name, redraws each at the model's full detail, then does the same for the eyes, and puts every crop back through a soft edge. The DA workflow's detailer: padding 32 and denoise 0.3 for faces, padding 8 and denoise 0.35 for eyes, 4 steps, seed 776. The group is a library group: save it to the library to drop it after any other template. Needs the Segment pack (offered at install) and its GroundingDINO model.
